push.title: W 3-2 vs Little Rocke FC | You: 9.2
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.2. You played with your head up and your heart out. Love to see it.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Little Rocke FC's goal. Shots are tickets to the goal lottery, and you bought a stack.
+ Man of the Match, your 18th for us. Man of the Match means everybody noticed, including me.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (21 vs their best 20). Keep that in your back pocket.
+ 2 goals conceded: +0.1. You did the boring stuff well, and it showed.

THE BAD
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 3. That needs to look different next time out.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 1 (best was buddskees's 3). That's the gap between a good night and a great one.
- Worst pass accuracy of your 7 matches this session (78%). Here's the play: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
- Shots on target: 75%. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 90%+ is something else.

Warm-up idea: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.

PhogsToffees, from me to you: If it was easy, everybody'd be in Division 1.

Keep the good times rolling. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs Little Rocke FC | You: 8.5
push.body:
buddskees, an 8.5. Good enough to be proud of, close enough to great to be hungry.

THE GOOD
+ 31 passes (up from your usual 19). You touched the ball more than a kid touches a cookie jar.
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (down from your usual 75%). Their attackers walked into you like a screen door.
+ 2 key passes. That's what I call neighborly football.
+ You and PhogsToffees linked up like peanut butter and jelly. Keep making sandwiches.
+ 0.4 up on your usual. Step by step, you're getting there.

THE BAD
- 71% passing (22 of 31, down from your usual 77%). Keep this in your pocket: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. That's a coach's honest word.
- Shots 0, down from your usual 2. Think about this: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.
- 2 goals conceded: -0.1. Attention to detail fixes this.
- Tackles attempted: 3. You're knocking on the 6+ door.
- Match rating 8.5, from 10.0 in your previous match. That has to tighten up.

Drill of the day: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

buddskees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Be a goldfish about mistakes and an elephant about lessons.

You're closer than you think. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs Little Rocke FC | You: 7.0
push.body:
A 7.0, BellyTb1. Even the best barbecue gets a little charred sometimes.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). That's a pass with a bow on it.
+ You and PhogsToffees combined like peanut butter and banana. Underrated and delicious.
+ Their humans averaged 7.0 to our 8.2; we out-played them man for man. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.
+ 3-2 over Little Rocke FC. Make it a habit.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. One more thing: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost. That's how good becomes great.
- Shots 1, down from your usual 4. Bread and butter: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.
- 0.7 under your usual. Bad days are tuition for good ones.
- 2 goals conceded took 0.1 away. Fixable.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 44%, down from your usual 72%. We can't win with that. Simple as that. Fundamentals: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

Rep it: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.

Last thing, BellyTb1. Quiet feet, loud heart.

Every great player has nights like this. Most of 'em just don't get a note from me. - Coach Lasso
